title.zh: O(1) 时间插入、删除和获取随机元素 — 允许重复
title.en: Insert Delete GetRandom O(1) - Duplicates allowed

desc.zh: 让每个副本占一个位置，用尾部填洞并修复位置集合。
desc.en: Give each copy a slot, fill a deletion hole from the tail, and repair its index set.

complexity: Expected amortized O(1) time per operation; O(n) space for n stored occurrences

concepts.name: Multiplicity-weighted sampling
concepts.description: Uniform positions give each value probability count / length.

concepts.name: Duplicate-aware swap deletion
concepts.description: Repair reverse index sets when the tail fills the deleted slot.
